findings.summary: The CLI special-cases deploymentCommit "HEAD" to checkedOutCommit "HEAD" instead of resolving the actual checkout identity, making both committed declarations' deployment-commit checks tautological and unable to enforce the checked-out deployment commit precondition.

Bounded checks are not integrated into the generic preflight runner: the CLI only invokes the synchronous evaluator, and contracts cannot declare bounded probes or timeouts, so an actual preflight timeout cannot become the required terminal attributable failed check.

The required acceptance commands are treated as passing solely from the seal-verified Implement handoff verification record, which records zero exits for npm ci, typecheck, tests, and smoke:cas, including 783 passing tests and one passing smoke check.
